newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Shell Mauritius interim 1996 profit up 5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Shell Mauritius interim 1996 profit up 5 percent.

text.p: Oil company Shell Mauritius reported on Monday a pre-tax profit of 20.2 million rupees ($980,000) for the six months period to 30 June 1996, up five per cent from the same period in 1995.
Shell's turnover for the same period increased by 21 per cent to 867 million rupees from 716.6 million rupees in 1995 and operating profit was 24 per cent higher to 35.0 million rupees.
Shell's profit for the whole year 1996 should be higher than in 1995, company officials said.
Shell Mauritius pre-tax profit for the year ending 31 December 1995 was posted at 28.8 million rupees on turnover of 1.54 billion rupees.
Shell Mauritius, whose parent company is the giant Royal Dutch/Shell Group, is one of four oil companies distributing petroleum products on the Mauritian local market.
